title: 👗 Clothes (одежда) & Present Simple vs Present Continuous
description: Учим названия одежды, учимся описывать, что мы носим обычно и что на нас сейчас. Мемы, мода и стиль! 👟

grammar.title: Clothes — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Основные предметы одежды**:

👕 **T-shirt** — футболка
👔 **shirt** — рубашка
👗 **dress** — платье
👖 **trousers** — брюки
👖 **jeans** — джинсы
🩳 **shorts** — шорты
🧥 **coat** — пальто
🧥 **jacket** — куртка
🧣 **scarf** — шарф
🧤 **gloves** — перчатки
🧢 **cap** — кепка
👟 **trainers** — кроссовки
👠 **high heels** — туфли на каблуке

🎯 **Мем**:
'What's your favourite outfit?'
'Hoodie and jeans. Every day. All year.' 😅👕

days.title: Day 2: Opposites — Adjectives for Clothes
days.description: Учим прилагательные-антонимы для описания одежды: long/short, heavy/light, tight/loose

grammar.title: Opposites (антонимы) для описания одежды
grammar.rule:
📘 **Прилагательные-антонимы для одежды**:

📏 **long** (длинный) ↔ **short** (короткий)
⚖️ **heavy** (тяжёлый) ↔ **light** (лёгкий)
👗 **tight** (обтягивающий) ↔ **loose** (свободный)

📌 **Примеры**:
✅ Anna is wearing a **long** skirt.
✅ He is wearing a **short** T-shirt.
✅ This coat is **heavy**. I can't carry it!
✅ I wear **light** clothes in summer.
✅ These jeans are too **tight**! I need a bigger size.
✅ I like **loose** hoodies. They are comfortable.

🎯 **Мем**:
'My jeans are too tight after dinner.'
'That's why I wear loose clothes to eat!' 😅

vocabulary.example: She is wearing a long dress.
I wear light clothes in summer.

exercises.question: These jeans are too ___ . I can't breathe! (tight / loose)
exercises.explanation: Tight — тесный, обтягивающий! Не могу дышать! 😅

exercises.question: I like ___ clothes in summer. (heavy / light)
exercises.explanation: Light clothes — лёгкая одежда для лета! ☀️

exercises.question: Anna is wearing a short dress.
exercises.correct: Anna is wearing a long dress.
accept: Anna is wearing a long dress
Anna is wearing a long dress.
exercises.explanation: Anna is wearing a LONG dress, not short! 📏

days.title: Day 3: What Are You Wearing? (Present Continuous)
days.description: Учимся говорить о том, что на нас сейчас

grammar.title: Present Continuous — одежда сейчас
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как сказать, что ты носишь прямо сейчас**:

📌 **Present Continuous**: to be + wearing
✅ I am wearing a T-shirt.
✅ He is wearing jeans.
✅ They are wearing trainers.

📌 **Вопросы**:
❓ What are you wearing? — Что на тебе сейчас?
❓ Is she wearing a dress? — На ней платье?

📌 **Ответы**:
✅ I am wearing a hoodie and jeans.
✅ No, he isn't wearing a coat.

🎯 **Мем**:
'What are you wearing right now?'
'A hoodie and pajama pants. 
It's a Zoom meeting outfit.' 😅💻

vocabulary.example: My dad is wearing a tie.

exercises.question: What are you wearing? 👕
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! I am wearing! 👕

exercises.readingText:
🌟 A FASHION SHOW AT SCHOOL 🌟

It's a special day at Oakwood Academy. The students are having a fashion show! They are wearing different outfits. Let's see what they're wearing!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👗 MIA
Mia is wearing a beautiful pink dress. She looks like a princess! She is wearing white shoes and a small bag. 'I feel like a celebrity!' she says. 🌟

👔 LEO
Leo is wearing a white shirt, black trousers and a red tie. He looks very serious. 'I don't like ties,' he says. 'But my mum made me wear it.' 😐

👕 SAM
Sam is wearing jeans, a T-shirt and a cap. He looks cool and casual. 'This is my everyday style!' he says. 'I never wear shirts or ties!' 😎

🧣 LEO'S MUM
Leo's mum is wearing a long dress and a scarf. She is taking photos of everyone. 'This is so much fun!' she says. 📸

🧥 TEACHER
Ms. Johnson is wearing a smart jacket and a blouse. She is the judge of the show. 'Everyone looks great!' she says. 🏆

👟 DAD
Leo's dad is wearing jeans and trainers. He is sitting in the audience. 'I'm comfortable!' he says. 😅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏆 AND THE WINNER IS...

Ms. Johnson: 'The winner of the fashion show is... MIA! Her dress is beautiful and she looks very elegant!'

Mia: 'Thank you! I'm so happy!' 🎉

Leo: 'I didn't win! But my tie didn't help me...' 😅

Sam: 'That's why I wear caps!' 😎

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 WHAT ARE YOU WEARING RIGHT NOW? 👇

days.title: Day 5: Present Simple vs Present Continuous Practice
days.description: Тренируемся выбирать между обычными действиями и тем, что на нас сейчас

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — одежда
grammar.rule:
📘 **Когда какое время использовать**:

📌 **Present Simple** (обычно, всегда):
✅ I usually wear jeans.
✅ She always wears a hat.

📌 **Present Continuous** (прямо сейчас):
✅ I am wearing a T-shirt right now.
✅ She is wearing a dress today.

🎯 **Ключевые слова**:
• Usually, always, sometimes, never → Present Simple
• Now, right now, today → Present Continuous

🎯 **Мем**:
'I usually wear pyjamas at home. 
But right now I am wearing a suit for a Zoom meeting. 
They don't know I'm wearing pyjamas on the bottom!' 😅

exercises.question: She ___ (usually / wear) a dress to parties. 👗
Right now, I ___ (wear) a hoodie. 👕
exercises.explanation: Right now = Present Continuous! I am wearing! 👕

exercises.question: 'I am wearing jeans' means it's a habit.
exercises.explanation: Am wearing = right now, not a habit! 👖

exercises.question: He usually ___ (wear) trainers. 👟 — Yes, but today he is wearing boots.

grammar.title: Повторение: одежда и времена
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What is your favourite outfit? (Какой твой любимый наряд?)
2️⃣ What does it look like? (Как он выглядит?)
3️⃣ When do you wear it? (Когда ты его носишь?)
4️⃣ What are you wearing right now? (Что на тебе сейчас?)
5️⃣ Why do you like this outfit? (Почему тебе нравится этот наряд?)

🎯 **Пример**:
My favourite outfit is a hoodie and jeans. The hoodie is blue and the jeans are black. I wear it to school and to meet friends. Right now, I am wearing a T-shirt and shorts because it's hot. I like this outfit because it's comfortable and cool! 😎

exercises.question: My favourite outfit is a ___ and ___ . (напиши одежду)
The hoodie is ___ and the jeans are ___ . (напиши цвета)
I like this outfit because it's ___ . (напиши причину)
